title: Zeppelin mothership (Download) angel block app and contest entry
author: Apimil

generated.description: A large airship build shaped like a zeppelin, with a long white wool and oak hull, iron block framing, and glass windows along the sides. It is about 117 wide, 58 high and 282 deep, a very long craft with many rooms and details, including chests, furnaces, an enchanting table, a cauldron, and signs. The source is a work in progress and a contest entry, and it was shared with a downloadable angel block app.
